description: This file implements intra-slice scheduling logic for a 5G NR network, including resource allocation for PDSCH and PUSCH, HARQ retransmissions, and candidate selection for uplink and downlink slices. It contains class methods for managing UE candidates, resource updates, and scheduling decisions within a scheduler component.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class responsible for intra-slice resource scheduling, candidate management, and resource allocation for UL and DL slices.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler::slice_ue_group_scheduler
classes.description: Helper class for managing UE candidate groups within a slice, including filling candidate groups for UL and DL.

methods.name: fill_ue_dl_candidate_group
methods.description: Fills the list of DL UE candidates for a given slice.

methods.name: fill_ue_ul_candidate_group
methods.description: Fills the list of UL UE candidates for a given slice.

methods.name: fill_ue_candidate_group
methods.description: Generic method to fill UE candidate group based on UL or DL direction.

methods.name: intra_slice_scheduler::intra_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with configuration, resource allocators, metrics, and logger.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the current slot for scheduling and resets attempt counters.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Performs post-processing after scheduling, such as updating UE allocation states.

methods.name: dl_sched
methods.description: Performs downlink scheduling for a slice, including retransmissions and new transmissions.

methods.name: ul_sched
methods.description: Performs uplink scheduling for a slice, including retransmissions and new transmissions.

methods.name: get_max_grants_and_rb_grant_size
methods.description: Calculates maximum RBs and grants per UE for a slice, considering resource limits and fairness.

methods.name: schedule_dl_retx_candidates
methods.description: Schedules downlink HARQ retransmission candidates.

methods.name: schedule_ul_retx_candidates
methods.description: Schedules uplink HARQ retransmission candidates.

methods.name: prepare_newtx_dl_candidates
methods.description: Prepares DL candidates for new transmissions and prioritizes them.

methods.name: prepare_newtx_ul_candidates
methods.description: Prepares UL candidates for new transmissions and prioritizes them.

methods.name: schedule_dl_newtx_candidates
methods.description: Allocates resources for new DL transmission candidates, deriving CRBs and grants.

methods.name: schedule_ul_newtx_candidates
methods.description: Allocates resources for new UL transmission candidates, deriving CRBs and grants.

methods.name: can_allocate_pdsch
methods.description: Checks if PDSCH can be allocated for a UE in the current slot.

methods.name: can_allocate_pusch
methods.description: Checks if PUSCH can be allocated for a UE in the current slot.

methods.name: create_newtx_dl_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new DL transmission candidate if the UE has pending data and resources are available.

methods.name: create_newtx_ul_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new UL transmission candidate if the UE has pending data and resources are available.

methods.name: max_pdschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of PDSCHs that can be allocated in a slot for a slice.

methods.name: max_puschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of PUSCHs that can be allocated in a slot for a slice.

methods.name: update_used_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Updates the VRB bitmap of used resources for downlink based on current allocations.

methods.name: update_used_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Updates the VRB bitmap of used resources for uplink based on current allocations.
